Family killed in car accident on National Highway 46 in Gujarat

A family of four was killed in a car accident on the National Highway 46 in Gujarat. The incident occurred when a bike was hit by a car traveling at high speed, resulting in fatal injuries to all occupants. The police are investigating the cause of the accident.
